_readme: Editorial fields the Qualtrics survey does not ask for, keyed by Qualtrics ResponseId.
import-survey.mjs merges these over each imported record. Survey fields are re-derived on every import; the fields here are not, so this is where hand-made decisions live.
Accepted keys: published, summary, slug, publicationStatus, geoNote, fullRecordUrl.
title is used only to match a row from a sheet without ResponseIds (the team's Submission Data sheet) to its ResponseId. It is never shown; the survey's own title is.
Topic areas are NOT set here: they are an LLM synthesis across all projects (topicSummaries.json), not a tag on any one project.
